item.description: The center market is thin, and that is great news for Brayden Schenn and Ryan O’Reilly. As Anthony DiMarco pointed out on TSN Radio in Montreal, Schenn has been in the St. Louis Blues rumor mill going back to last season, yet his name is gaining traction again with the team stuck near the bottom of the standings. item.title: Vancouver Canucks Rejecting Multiple Trade Offers

item.title: Ryan Reaves Calls Out Maple Leafs—Again—In His Return to Toronto
item.description: We heard before the season that Ryan Reaves wasn't happy with how things ended for him with the Toronto Maple Leafs. Now that he's in town with the San Jose Sharks for his first game back at Scotiabank Arena against his old squad, he's taking no prisoners—on the ice or off it.
